entities.summary: Erwin Puchinger was a Viennese painter, illustrator, industrial designer and graphic artist. He was an influential figure in Viennese art in the fin-de-siecle. Puchinger was a part of the Austrian Jugendstil and Gesamtkunstwerk movements, which sought to erase the boundaries between fine art and applied art. Puchinger worked in London, Prague and Paris as well as Vienna and collaborated with other major figures in Viennese art and design such as Ernst and Gustav Klimt and Otto Prutscher. He was a respected art professor at the Graphic Arts Institute, where he taught for more than thirty years.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent figure in Viennese art and design, Erwin Puchinger's work contributed to the development of the Austrian Jugendstil and Gesamtkunstwerk movements. His collaborations with notable artists like Klimt and Prutscher helped shape the aesthetic of fin-de-siecle Vienna.
